tldr: 台股高檔整理，全球債券殖利率走高壓抑科技權值股，AI 供應鏈仍是盤面主軸。
台積電 AI 營收挑戰兆元、訂單能見度直達 2028 年，輝達更把 AI 導入晶圓廠製程。
金管會為接軌 IFRS 17 重塑壽險業，台灣高資產人口與財富管理規模持續擴張。
台灣 7 月出口 753 億美元、史上第 3 高，主計總處將 2026 年 GDP 成長上修至約 11%。
美股收黑，美國財政部倍增長天期公債回購但殖利率仍逼近 19 年高點，美債總額突破 40 兆美元。

items.title_zh: 台股高檔震盪整理，全球殖利率牽動
items.title_en: TAIEX consolidates near record highs as global yields bite
items.summary_zh: 加權指數最新交易日回落約 1.3%、退守約 44,700 點，延續月初重返 46,000 點後的整理格局。全球債券殖利率走高與美國大型科技股降溫拖累以半導體為主的台股，但 AI 硬體需求持續撐住權值股，中長多頭趨勢未破，資金仍聚焦 AI 供應鏈。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index pulled back about 1.3% in its latest session to roughly 44,700 points, extending a bout of consolidation after reclaiming the 46,000 level earlier in the month. Rising global bond yields and a cooling in US megacap tech weighed on Taiwan's semiconductor-heavy market, though AI hardware demand continued to underpin index heavyweights and keep the broader uptrend intact.

items.title_zh: 記憶體概念股重回鎂光燈
items.title_en: Memory-chip concept stocks return to the spotlight
items.summary_zh: 除高股息標的外，記憶體族群受惠 AI 伺服器需求帶動 DRAM、HBM 報價走揚，再度成為盤面主流。資金輪動至記憶體供應鏈，使市場領漲族群不再侷限於晶圓代工龍頭，也顯示 AI 資本支出循環正外溢至更廣泛的零組件廠商。
items.summary_en: Beyond high-dividend favourites, memory-related names have re-emerged as a leading theme in Taipei trading as DRAM and HBM pricing firms up on AI-server demand. Investors rotated toward memory supply-chain plays, broadening market leadership beyond foundry giants and signalling that the AI capex cycle is spilling into a wider set of component makers.

items.title_zh: 台積電 AI 營收衝兆元、能見度達 2028
items.title_en: TSMC AI revenue nears trillion mark, visibility to 2028
items.summary_zh: 受惠輝達、超微、博通等大客戶，台積電 AI 相關營收逼近兆元大關，訂單能見度延伸至 2028 年。管理層指引 2026 年營收成長近三成，並將資本支出上調至 600 至 640 億美元、七至八成投入先進製程，凸顯 AI 投資循環對台灣供應鏈的續航力。
items.summary_en: TSMC's AI-related revenue is closing in on the trillion-dollar milestone with order visibility now extending to 2028, powered by Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom. Management guides 2026 revenue growth near 30% and has lifted capex to US$60–64 billion, with 70–80% earmarked for advanced nodes — underscoring the durability of the AI investment cycle for Taiwan's supply chain.

items.title_zh: 輝達把 AI 導入台積電晶圓廠
items.title_en: Nvidia embeds AI across TSMC's fabs
items.summary_zh: 輝達將加速運算與 AI 技術全面導入台積電營運，運用 cuLitho、CUDA-X 函式庫於微影製程、製程控制與瑕疵檢測。此合作意在提升製造效率與良率，進一步深化全球晶片設計龍頭與關鍵晶圓代工夥伴的策略連結。
items.summary_en: Nvidia is deploying its accelerated-computing and AI stack throughout TSMC's operations, applying tools such as cuLitho and CUDA-X libraries to lithography, process control and defect inspection. The collaboration aims to lift manufacturing efficiency and yield, deepening the strategic tie between the world's top chip designer and its key foundry partner.

items.title_zh: 金管會八項新制 壽險業大轉型
items.title_en: FSC readies eight new rules to reshape life insurers
items.summary_zh: 金管會公布明年上路的八項新制，壽險業迎接圍繞 IFRS 17 與新清償能力制度的重大轉型。新制涵蓋資本、資訊揭露與商品規範，促使壽險公司在接軌會計新制前強化資產負債結構、調整經營模式，牽動整體金融業體質。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Financial Supervisory Commission has outlined eight new measures taking effect next year as the life-insurance industry braces for a major transformation around IFRS 17 and the new solvency regime. The package covers capital, disclosure and product standards, pushing insurers to strengthen balance sheets and adapt business models ahead of the accounting transition.

items.title_zh: 過渡措施紓解壽險資本壓力
items.title_en: Transitional measures ease insurers' capital strain
items.summary_zh: 為協助平順接軌 TIS 與 IFRS 17，主管機關提供過渡措施，使八家壽險型金控資本壓力顯著減壓，另有 11 家可延後申報資本適足率。此舉為業者爭取時間累積準備金、管理利率敏感度，避免資本適足陷入急遽衝擊。
items.summary_en: To smooth the TIS/IFRS 17 transition, regulators granted transitional relief that materially reduces capital pressure for eight insurance-oriented financial holding companies, while 11 firms may defer their capital-adequacy-ratio filings. The move buys the sector time to build reserves and manage interest-rate sensitivity without abrupt capital shocks.

items.title_zh: 台灣高資產人口續增、ETF 規模逾 7.4 兆
items.title_en: Taiwan's ultra-wealthy ranks swell, ETF pool tops NT$7.4tn
items.summary_zh: 據 KPMG 與玉山銀行調研，台灣資產逾新台幣 1 億元的高資產人口 2025 年增至 11.8 萬人，2026 年估逼近 12.4 萬人，合計持有數十兆元資產。同時全台 ETF 規模已衝上 7.4 兆元，反映散戶與高資產客群對包裝型投資商品的需求持續深化。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's population holding assets above NT$100 million rose to 118,000 in 2025 and is projected near 124,000 in 2026, collectively holding tens of trillions of NT dollars, per a KPMG–E.Sun study. Meanwhile the local ETF pool has surged past NT$7.4 trillion, reflecting deepening retail and high-net-worth appetite for packaged investment products.

items.title_zh: 銀行力推私募市場與家族辦公室
items.title_en: Banks push private markets and family offices
items.summary_zh: 亞資高峰論壇上，銀行業指出高資產客戶需要的是整合式財富管理，而非更多商品，呼籲擴大布局私募股權、私募債權、避險基金與家族辦公室等另類資產，並深化跨境財管。台灣基金、保險商品已成熟，但另類投資仍落後國際私銀，成為下一個競爭焦點。
items.summary_en: At a regional asset-management forum, bankers said high-net-worth clients need integrated wealth services rather than more products, urging expansion into alternative assets — private equity, private credit, hedge funds and family-office structures — and deeper cross-border wealth management. Taiwan's fund and insurance products are mature, but alternatives lag international private banks, marking the next competitive frontier.

items.title_zh: 遺產稅新法上路，減輕繼承人負擔
items.title_en: New estate-tax rules ease the burden on heirs
items.summary_zh: 台灣修正後的遺產稅制度，讓「擬制遺產」得以分開課稅，不再由單一繼承人一次承擔，且連小額稅款都可申請分期。此舉旨在使資產傳承更公平、對家庭現金流更友善，避免單一受益人為繼承資產背負不成比例的稅負。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's revised estate-tax framework lets "deemed estate" assets be taxed separately rather than piled onto a single heir, and even small liabilities can now be paid in instalments. The change aims to make succession fairer and cash-flow friendlier for families, reducing cases where one beneficiary shoulders a disproportionate tax bill on inherited assets.

items.title_zh: 遺產稅級距隨累計通膨調整
items.title_en: Estate-tax brackets adjusted for cumulative inflation
items.summary_zh: 因累計 CPI 較上次調整上漲 12.42%，2026 年遺產稅課稅級距上調：淨額 5,621 萬元以下 10%、5,621 萬至 1 億 1,242 萬元 15%、超過部分 20%，而 1,333 萬元免稅額維持不變。此調整緩解通膨造成的級距擠壓，略為降低中等規模遺產的有效稅率。
items.summary_en: With cumulative CPI up 12.42% since the last revision, Taiwan's estate-tax brackets have been raised for 2026: 10% up to NT$56.21m, 15% on NT$56.21m–112.42m, and 20% above that, while the NT$13.33m exemption stays unchanged. The move eases bracket creep for estates, marginally lowering effective rates on mid-sized inheritances.

items.title_zh: 7 月出口 753 億美元、史上第 3 高
items.title_en: July exports hit US$75.3bn, third-highest on record
items.summary_zh: 台灣 7 月出口達 753 億美元、年增 32.9%，連續 33 個月正成長，受 AI 需求帶動、電子零組件出口創單月新高。財政部預估全年出口可望輕鬆突破 8,500 億美元；惟傳統產業受關稅與全球需求放緩影響、動能承壓。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's July exports reached US$75.3 billion, up 32.9% year-on-year and a 33rd straight month of growth, driven by record electronic-component shipments amid AI demand. The finance ministry expects full-year exports to comfortably exceed US$850 billion, though traditional sectors face pressure from tariffs and softer global demand.

items.title_zh: 主計總處上修 2026 GDP 至約 11%
items.title_en: Statistics agency lifts 2026 GDP forecast toward 11%
items.summary_zh: 台灣主計總處將 2026 年 GDP 成長預測上修至約 11%，可望創 1987 年以來最強，受 AI 帶動出口與內需回溫推升。上修同時牽動通膨疑慮，使下半年是否升息成為市場關注焦點。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's budget agency raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to about 11%, poised to be the strongest since 1987, as AI-driven exports and a recovery in domestic demand power the economy. The upgrade also stokes inflation concerns, keeping a possible second-half rate hike squarely in market focus.

items.title_zh: 費半重挫約 5% 拖累美股
items.title_en: Philadelphia Semiconductor Index dives ~5%, dragging US stocks
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，美債殖利率走揚使原本偏高的 AI 期待反成壓力，費城半導體指數重挫約 5%、拖累美股大盤。晶片股領跌效應擴散至亞洲科技供應鏈，也加深台灣半導體投資人的觀望心態。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported that rising US Treasury yields turned lofty AI expectations into a headwind, sending the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index down about 5% and weighing on the broader US market. The chip-led selloff rippled through Asia's tech supply chain, reinforcing caution among Taiwan's semiconductor investors.

items.title_zh: 美債突破 40 兆美元、殖利率測試多年高點
items.title_en: US debt tops US$40 trillion as yields test multi-year highs
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體聚焦美國聯邦債務突破 40 兆美元、以疫情以來最快速度膨脹，形成「債愈高、息愈重、借更多」的循環。美國財政部宣布長天期公債回購規模至少倍增以壓抑借貸成本，此動向為台灣債市與股市投資人密切關注。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese outlets highlighted that US federal debt has crossed US$40 trillion and is swelling at its fastest pace since the pandemic, driving a "higher debt, heavier interest, more borrowing" spiral. The US Treasury's move to at least double long-dated bond buybacks aims to cap borrowing costs, a dynamic closely watched by Taiwan's bond and equity investors.

items.title_zh: 美股收黑，債券殖利率壓力再起（2026-08-20）
items.title_en: US stocks fall as bond-yield relief evaporates (2026-08-20)
items.summary_zh: 儘管財政部加大回購，美債殖利率仍再度走揚，美股回落。標普 500 跌 0.87% 收 7,641.16 點，那斯達克跌約 1% 收 26,067.17 點，道瓊跌 703.84 點（1.32%）收 52,759.21 點；投資人憂心較高借貸成本恐拖累多頭行情。
items.summary_en: Wall Street dropped as Treasury yields resumed climbing despite the Treasury's buyback push. The S&P 500 fell 0.87% to 7,641.16, the Nasdaq slid about 1% to 26,067.17, and the Dow lost 703.84 points (1.32%) to 52,759.21, as investors fretted that higher borrowing costs could throttle the bull market.

items.title_zh: 財政部倍增回購，長天期殖利率仍走高（2026-08-20）
items.title_en: Treasury doubles buybacks but long yields keep rising (2026-08-20)
items.summary_zh: 美國財政部將長天期公債流動性回購規模倍增至每次至少 40 億美元，但緩解僅曇花一現。10 年期殖利率升 4.7 個基點至 4.70%，30 年期升 5.5 個基點至 5.249%、逼近 19 年高點，市場對政府債務膨脹的疑慮未消。
items.summary_en: The US Treasury doubled liquidity-support buybacks of longer-dated notes to at least US$4bn per operation, but relief proved brief. The 10-year yield climbed 4.7bp to 4.70% and the 30-year rose 5.5bp to 5.249%, near a 19-year high, as worries over swelling government debt persisted.

items.title_zh: 沃爾瑪第 2 季財報優於預期（2026-08-20）
items.summary_zh: 沃爾瑪公布第 2 季每股盈餘 0.81 美元，優於市場預期的 0.74 美元、超出 7 美分，股東權益報酬率 21.25%、淨利率 3.13%。這份優於預期的財報顯示消費支出仍具韌性，在大盤因利率疑慮走跌之際提供一抹亮點。
items.summary_en: Walmart reported second-quarter EPS of US$0.81, beating the US$0.74 consensus by seven cents, with return on equity of 21.25% and a 3.13% net margin. The retailer's beat signalled resilient consumer spending, offering a bright spot even as broader indices sold off on rate worries.

items.title_zh: 美債突破 40 兆美元、聯準會壓力升高（2026-08-19）
items.title_en: US debt tops US$40tn, piling pressure on the Fed (2026-08-19)
items.summary_zh: 隨聯邦債務突破 40 兆美元，財政部長貝森特擴大公債回購一度壓低殖利率，卻也對沃許主政的聯準會形成維持寬鬆的政治壓力。分析師警告，此干預頂多是全球債市壓力的「斷路器」，而非根本解方。
items.summary_en: With federal debt crossing US$40 trillion, Treasury Secretary Bessent's move to upscale buybacks initially sent yields lower but added political pressure on Warsh's Fed to keep policy accommodative. Analysts warned the intervention is at best a circuit-breaker, not a cure, for the global bond-market strains.
